definition: A technique that stores and reuses the processed representation of frequently repeated prompt content (such as a long system prompt) to avoid redundant computation on subsequent requests.
details: Prompt caching can significantly reduce latency and cost for applications that repeatedly send the same or overlapping context, such as a fixed system prompt or a large document referenced across many queries.
story: Think of a jazz musician who has heard so many solos that a new one simply falls out of their fingers. Here is the short version: A technique that stores and reuses the processed representation of frequently repeated prompt content (such as a long system prompt) to avoid redundant computation on subsequent requests. The part that makes it sing: Prompt caching can significantly reduce latency and cost for applications that repeatedly send the same or overlapping context, such as a fixed system prompt or a large document referenced across many queries. Creation, here, is memory recombined at speed. And that is Prompt Caching — making something new out of everything it has ever seen.
